🌽 Maize Pathogen Database (MPDB)

Curated Reference Database for Maize Pathogen Identification

Search by Species Name or Taxonomy

Enter genus, species, family, or disease name to find maize pathogens.

Search by DNA Sequence

✓ Fingerprint database loaded (201 species with sequences)
How it works: Paste DNA sequence (FASTA format). Extracts 25-mer fingerprints and performs rapid screening against a species-level fingerprint index covering the 201 species with reference sequences.
Recommended: 16S rRNA (≥300 bp) or ITS region (≥300 bp). Minimum 50 bp required.

Submit a New Pathogen

How it works: If you have identified a maize pathogen that is not yet in the Maize Pathogen Database (MPDB), submit the information below. The submission will be reviewed and, if approved, the database will be updated.

Requirements: Scientific name must be recognized by NCBI Taxonomy (valid TaxID required). Marker gene sequence must be ≥100 bp. At least one literature reference is required for verification.

Look up at NCBI Taxonomy

Minimum 100 bp. Include a header line starting with >.

You will receive an email confirmation after submission. The review process typically takes 1-2 weeks.

Annotate Species List for Maize Pathogens

How it works: Upload a CSV or TSV file containing species names and/or NCBI TaxIDs. The tool matches each row against the Maize Pathogen Database (MPDB) and returns an annotated file with pathogen status, matched species, taxonomy, and disease information.

Accepted formats: CSV (comma) or TSV (tab). First row must be a header. Include a column named species, taxon, scientific_name, or TaxID. If no recognized header is found, the first column is treated as the species name.
